title: Level 4 (Expert) - B-7
notes:
West leads the ♥K against 6♠. West's heart opening lead should be won with the ♥A. South should try to draw trump, playing a spade to the ♠A or ♠K. When West discards, the contract is in jeopardy.

South's best plan is to play the ♦K and overtake with North's ♦A. South can pick up East's spades with the aid of the proven finesse. South now tries to get back the diamond trick he previously compressed. He finesses West for the ♦J. As East started with all 3 spades, this finesse is better than even money to succeed. South cashes dummy's ♦Q for a discard and surrenders a trick at the end.
